description: Map ClinVar pathogenic GATAD2B variants onto p66-beta domain architecture; test CR1/CR2 enrichment; estimate GAND birth prevalence
code:
import requests, re, time, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
from scipy.stats import beta as betadist

E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
r=requests.get(E+"esearch.fcgi",params=dict(db="clinvar",term="GATAD2B[gene]",retmax=1000,retmode="json"),timeout=60)
ids=r.json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    j=requests.get(E+"esummary.fcgi",params=dict(db="clinvar",id=",".join(ids[i:i+200]),retmode="json"),timeout=120).json()["result"]
    for uid in j.get("uids",[]):
        d=j[uid]; g=d.get("germline_classification",{})
        recs.append(dict(title=d.get("title",""),clinsig=g.get("description","")))
    time.sleep(0.4)
df=pd.DataFrame(recs)

AA3=r"(?:Ala|Arg|Asn|Asp|Cys|Gln|Glu|Gly|His|Ile|Leu|Lys|Met|Phe|Pro|Ser|Thr|Trp|Tyr|Val|Ter)"
def protpos(t, kind):
    if kind=="missense":
        m=re.search(rf"p\.({AA3})(\d+)({AA3})\)",t)
        if m and m.group(3)!="Ter": return int(m.group(2))
    if kind=="trunc":
        m=re.search(rf"p\.({AA3})(\d+)(?:Ter|[A-Z][a-z]{{2}}fs)",t)
        if m: return int(m.group(2))
    return None

plp=df[df.clinsig.str.contains("Pathogenic",na=False)]
vus=df[df.clinsig=="Uncertain significance"]
ben=df[df.clinsig.str.contains("enign",na=False)]

plp_mis=[p for p in plp.title.map(lambda t:protpos(t,"missense")) if p]
plp_tr =[p for p in plp.title.map(lambda t:protpos(t,"trunc")) if p]
vus_mis=[p for p in vus.title.map(lambda t:protpos(t,"missense")) if p]
ben_mis=[p for p in ben.title.map(lambda t:protpos(t,"missense")) if p]
print("P/LP missense positions:",sorted(plp_mis))
print("P/LP truncating positions (n=%d): %s"%(len(plp_tr),sorted(plp_tr)))
print("VUS missense n=%d ; Benign/LB missense n=%d"%(len(vus_mis),len(ben_mis)))

# domains
CR1=(165,195); CR2=(340,480); ZNF=(414,467); L=593
def infrac(pos,dom): return sum(dom[0]<=p<=dom[1] for p in pos)
dom_len=(CR1[1]-CR1[0]+1)+(CR2[1]-CR2[0]+1)
exp_frac=dom_len/L
from scipy.stats import binomtest
for nm,pos in [("P/LP missense",plp_mis),("VUS missense",vus_mis),("Benign/LB missense",ben_mis)]:
    k=infrac(pos,CR1)+infrac(pos,CR2); n=len(pos)
    if n:
        bt=binomtest(k,n,exp_frac,alternative="greater")
        print(f"{nm}: {k}/{n} ({100*k/n:.0f}%) fall in CR1+CR2 (expected {100*exp_frac:.0f}% by length); binomial p={bt.pvalue:.4g}")

# ---------- Prevalence estimate from published NDD cohorts ----------
print("\n=== GAND frequency among severe/moderate ID-NDD probands (published cohorts) ===")
coh=pd.DataFrame([
    ("Hamdan 2014 (PMID 25356899), moderate/severe ID trios, Canada",41,1),
    ("Pande 2024 (PMID 38114583), syndromic ID with de novo variants, India",54,1),
],columns=["cohort","n","gatad2b"])
coh["pct"]=100*coh.gatad2b/coh.n
tot_n=coh.n.sum(); tot_k=coh.gatad2b.sum()
lo,hi=betadist.ppf(0.025,tot_k,tot_n-tot_k+1), betadist.ppf(0.975,tot_k+1,tot_n-tot_k)
print(coh.to_string(index=False))
print(f"Pooled: {tot_k}/{tot_n} = {100*tot_k/tot_n:.2f}% (95% CI {100*lo:.2f}-{100*hi:.2f}%)")
print("NOTE: these denominators are *solved* ID cohorts, so this is an upper-bound-prone estimate.")

# Derived population prevalence: severe ID prevalence ~0.3-0.4% of births (literature consensus)
for sid in [0.003,0.004]:
    for f,lab in [(tot_k/tot_n,"point"),(lo,"lower"),(hi,"upper")]:
        pass
pt=tot_k/tot_n
print("\nDerived birth prevalence of GAND, assuming moderate/severe ID birth prevalence 0.3-0.4%:")
for sid,lbl in [(0.003,"0.3%"),(0.004,"0.4%")]:
    print(f"  severe/moderate ID = {lbl}:  point {1e5*sid*pt:.2f} per 100,000  (95% CI {1e5*sid*lo:.2f} - {1e5*sid*hi:.2f})")

# ---------- Figure: lollipop of variants on domain map ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,5))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1,-0.22),L,0.44,facecolor="#DDE1E6",edgecolor="k",lw=0.6))
for (s,e),c,lab in [(CR1,"#4C72B0","CR1 165-195\nMBD2/MBD3 binding"),
                    (CR2,"#DD8452","CR2 340-480\nhistone-tail binding, CHD3/CHD4 recruitment"),
                    (ZNF,"#55A868","GATA-type Zn finger\n414-467")]:
    y=-0.22 if lab.startswith("GATA")==False else -0.14
    h=0.44 if not lab.startswith("GATA") else 0.28
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((s,y),e-s,h,facecolor=c,edgecolor="k",lw=0.6,alpha=0.95))
    ax.text((s+e)/2, 0.40 if lab.startswith("CR1") else (0.40 if lab.startswith("CR2") else -0.55),
            lab,ha="center",va="bottom" if not lab.startswith("GATA") else "top",fontsize=8.5)

for p in plp_tr:
    ax.plot([p,p],[0.22,0.95],c="#999999",lw=0.7,zorder=1)
    ax.plot(p,0.95,"o",ms=4,c="#8C8C8C",zorder=2)
for p in plp_mis:
    ax.plot([p,p],[0.22,1.5],c="#C44E52",lw=1.3,zorder=3)
    ax.plot(p,1.5,"o",ms=8,c="#C44E52",zorder=4)
    ax.annotate(str(p),(p,1.55),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#C44E52")
ax.plot([],[],"o",c="#8C8C8C",label="P/LP truncating (n=%d)"%len(plp_tr))
ax.plot([],[],"o",c="#C44E52",label="P/LP missense (n=%d)"%len(plp_mis))
ax.set_xlim(-10,L+25); ax.set_ylim(-1.0,2.1); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("p66-beta (GATAD2B, UniProt Q8WXI9) amino acid position, 593 aa")
ax.set_title("Pathogenic GATAD2B missense variants fall in the conserved CR1/CR2 interaction domains,\nwhile truncating variants are distributed across the protein")
ax.legend(loc="upper left",frameon=False)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
